title: +UNPACKING LIFE EXPECTANCY IN THE U.S.
description: Considers a range of factors which help explain why other advanced democracies outperform the United States on common measures of health and well-being. Broadly examines how unhealthy behaviors, unsafe environments, fractured policy, and disparate socioeconomic conditions contribute to lower average life expectancy in the U.S. compared to other high-income countries.
